method: All decisions and actual denied tool results. Primary decision means semantic reviewer for guard/anchored and deterministic contract executor for contract. Banking native tools independently replayed to final saved state; blocked hard-rule operations tested on their exact pre-operation state. Semantic allow followed by hard deny is not executed.
caveat: Hard rule imposes an explicit original-request policy on delegated recipient changes; source authenticity is unresolved. Same-task post-hoc candidate, fixed attacks, no population reliability guarantee. Zero ASR without a proposed write is never counted as an interception.
